scripts.build:server: tsc -p tsconfig.server.json && esbuild ./server/productionServer.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node20 --outfile=dist-server/server.mjs && esbuild ./server/postgresOperationalStore.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node20 --packages=external --outfile=dist-server/postgresOperationalStore.mjs && esbuild ./server/migrateDatabase.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node20 --packages=external --outfile=dist-server/migrateDatabase.mjs && esbuild ./server/bootstrapProductionUser.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node20 --packages=external --outfile=dist-server/bootstrapProductionUser.mjs && node scripts/copy-server-migrations.mjs
scripts.test: tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json && powershell -NoProfile -Command "$pkg = Join-Path '.tmp-tests' 'package.json'; Set-Content -LiteralPath $pkg -Value '{\"type\":\"commonjs\"}' -NoNewline; node --test .tmp-tests/tests/*.test.js; Remove-Item -Recurse -Force .tmp-tests"
scripts.i18n:audit: tsc --module commonjs --target es2020 --moduleResolution node --esModuleInterop --skipLibCheck --outDir .tmp-i18n-audit scripts/i18n-audit.ts && powershell -NoProfile -Command "$pkg = Join-Path '.tmp-i18n-audit' 'package.json'; Set-Content -LiteralPath $pkg -Value '{\"type\":\"commonjs\"}' -NoNewline; node .tmp-i18n-audit/scripts/i18n-audit.js; Remove-Item -Recurse -Force .tmp-i18n-audit"
